# outfmt 17 (SAM) fixtures

`snucl_bt.fna`: `snucl.fna` plus a third subject `sn3` of random letters (no hit of any query here) with the byte 0xE9 in
its title, the FASTA of the database `db/snucl_bt` (`tests/outfmt17_blastn.rs`); added in commit 40c7d9e9b (2026-10-22). The
letters were not made by a script kept in the repository.
